messages:
alex_partnerships: Quick thread — building a private offer for Marketplace Q2 renewals. Need opinions on tranching (commit buckets) vs SKU banding (per-feature discounts). Goal: accelerate renewals with minimal price erosion.
rachael_revenue_ops: Love it. Can we define success metrics first? Renewal rate lift, ARR retained, and average discount depth per deal.
mike_sales: From field: customers want predictability. Smaller tranches (monthly/quarterly) are easier for mid-market. Enterprises prefer 12/36m commits w/ true-up.
sujan_platform: Important: some SKUs (Private, Dedicated) have different unit economics. SKU banding makes sense if we can map margin bands to discount caps.
alex_partnerships: Right — proposal idea: 3-tier tranching: Bronze (<$100k/yr) 10% off credits, Silver ($100-500k) 18% + 1 free onboarding credit, Gold (>$500k) 25% + extended support. SKU banding = apply smaller add-on discounts on infra-heavy SKUs.
rachael_revenue_ops: Also consider renewal accelerator: 1) extra 3% discount if they sign 60 days before term end, 2) rollover credits if they upcommit.
elaine_marketing: We should standardize the messaging for Marketplace listing — "commit + private offer = guaranteed capacity & lower unit price" — keeps it simple for buyers.
mike_sales: One risk: discount stacking. Need guardrails: max effective discount per customer = 30%. Also require baseline usage reports quarterly.
sujan_platform: Operational note: private offers for Dedicated require EDP-esque documentation. We need templated legal terms + SOW addendum for burst capacity.
alex_partnerships: Can someone sketch a sample offer payload for Marketplace? simple fields: commit_amount, term_months, sku_bands, discount_table, early_sign_bonus.
rachael_revenue_ops: I'll draft the discount_table matrix. Example CSV snippet:
```
commit_band,min_discount,max_discount,bonus
0-100k,5,10,0
100k-500k,12,18,1_onboarding_credit
500k+,20,25,priority_support
```
mike_sales: Perfect. Also flag for renewals: 5% step-down on renewal unless they increase commit (to encourage upsell).
elaine_marketing: Can we get a microsite and one-pager for sellers? I'll own that if you finalize tiers.
deploy-bot: reminder: marketplace metadata validation job succeeded for private-offer schema v1.2
alex_partnerships: Next steps: Rachael to share draft discount_table + terms by EOD Thu. Mike to validate field acceptance. Sujan to list operational blockers. We'll sync Fri 10am.
rachael_revenue_ops: On it.
mike_sales: I'll check with top 5 renewal targets and share sensitivity.
sujan_platform: Will enumerate infra SKUs and cost bands.
elaine_marketing: I'll draft seller one-pager.
alex_partnerships: Thanks team :thumbsup:
